_readme: Hand-curated corrections applied by scripts/build-network-graph.js.
Never edit tti_nodes.csv or tti_edges.csv to fix something; correct it here
so the next board export does not undo the work.
merges        - one entity drawn in several Miro frames. Two different
entities that share a name (Gateway Academy) do NOT belong
here; the build keeps them apart automatically.
aliases       - other names an entity is known by, used for search and for
matching against the facility records.
kinds         - person | facility | parent | association | government |
church | other. Wins over every rule.
relationships - raw relationship string -> category and roles.
facilities    - board name -> facilities_v2 id, or null to accept no match.
acquirers     - edge id -> the name of the party that did the acquiring.
headline      - the organisations the map opens on, in order. Chosen for
influence and prevalence, which is an editorial judgement
and not something a degree count can work out: Synanon has
six recorded connections and belongs here; plenty of nodes
with thirty do not. Names must match a node exactly.
statuses      - board name -> open | closed | rebranded. The build splits
the board's "closed or rebranded" using the rebrand edges;
correct a wrong call here (see tmp/network-qa.md).
years         - board name -> "1971-2004" (or "from 1998"), for an
organisation no facility or operator record dates.
formerNames   - board name -> ["the name it traded under before", ...],
for a company or trade group no facility or operator
record covers. Drawn on the map under the current name
and listed in the drawer. Where the OLD name is itself
a node on the board, do not put it here: give the two
an edge with the relationship "rebrand" instead, so
both names stay on the map joined by a Became arrow.
deaths        - board name -> number of memorial deaths, for memorial rows
the build could not place on a node.
chainColours  - chain -> the line colour the board draws that company's
connections in, read off the Miro frames (2026-09-18).
regionChains  - board frame -> chain whose colour its lines carry, where
the frame is not itself a chain (Wilderness is Aspen's).
membershipColour - the board's colour for NATSAP membership lines.
nodes         - organisations and people the board is missing: {"name",
"kind", "aliases", "network" (frame), "near" (a board node
to start beside), "dates", "status", "source"}.
edges         - lines the board is missing: {"from", "to", "relationship",
"category", "source"}. Worded like the board's own labels;
a category settles what the wording alone would not
("operated 1993-1999" names no role the rules know); source
is the citation, for reviewers.
lines         - lines the board DOES draw but labels wrongly, or not at
all: {"from", "to", "relationship", "category",
"source"}. Matched on the pair of names either way
round, and rewritten in the order given here, so the
caption reads the right way. Use this rather than an
edge id: ids are row positions and the next export
moves them. `relationships` cannot reach an unlabelled
line, because the wording is what is missing.
views         - other lists the map can open on, offered as "Start from":
{"key": {"label": "Shown in the select", "names": [...]}}.
Keys are lowercase with hyphens; "default" is the headline.
The select only appears once there is at least one view.
List the organisations (and any person to keep); the build
adds every shortest route joining them and anyone linked
directly to two of them, so nothing on the view floats free.
Run `node scripts/build-network-graph.js` after any edit and work through
tmp/network-qa.md.
